en.title: Using Chinese bike prices from abroad: what a yuan figure does not include
en.description: Separate domestic observations, currency-converted references and export quotes before comparing Chinese bikes or framesets internationally.
en.intro: China Bikes primarily documents purchases in mainland China. International readers can use it to discover models and inspect specifications, but a yuan price is not automatically an export offer, a landed cost or a worldwide warranty.

sections.heading: First identify what kind of number you are reading
paragraphs: An observed domestic price, a coupon-linked search card, an official list price and a foreign-currency reference conversion are different evidence types. The model page preserves the observation date and conditions so you can tell them apart. A converted reference may describe an overseas purchase rather than a mainland-China offer.

The LCR018-D record is an example: its displayed frame reference comes from an owner-reported foreign-currency purchase converted at a dated rate. That does not make it an independently observed Chinese checkout price. The table below labels the basis instead of hiding it behind the currency symbol.

sections.heading: Confirm that the export quote describes the same bike
paragraphs: Send the seller the model generation, size, color and exact component package you are comparing. Ask whether the quote is for a bare frame, a frame package, a partially assembled bike or a complete build. Regional versions and similarly named configurations must not silently share one price or weight.
Use the linked model pages to identify the questions, not to assume that every regional option matches. A photograph of a desirable wheelset does not establish that the quoted package includes it.

sections.heading: Create a landed-cost worksheet without guessing
paragraphs: Use separate lines for the product quote, packing or handling, transport, insurance where selected, payment or currency-conversion charges, any destination-specific import costs, and local assembly or inspection. Obtain current amounts and applicability from the seller, carrier and relevant destination authorities. This article supplies no universal tax rate or duty estimate.

Leave unquoted items blank rather than entering zero. Keep the currency and quotation date beside each amount. Only then compare the total with an option available locally. A low domestic starting price can still be useful information without being the cheapest delivered result.

sections.heading: Treat support as part of the decision
paragraphs: Ask who accepts a warranty claim in your destination, which documents are required, and who pays transport or labor for a claim. Confirm how returns work before paying and whether a replacement hanger, seatpost, cockpit or other model-specific part can be shipped separately.
Do not interpret a domestic warranty statement as a promise that an overseas distributor or workshop will handle the product. Get the applicable policy for the exact seller, product and destination.

sections.heading: The catalog is most useful as a research starting point
paragraphs: Use it to shortlist exact models, compare documented standards and find original sources. The [methodology](/methodology/) explains the distinction between recorded facts, estimates and unresolved questions. For frame purchases, also read [how to budget a complete build](/blog/frameset-vs-complete-bike-cost-in-china/).

No shipping coverage, stock or foreign checkout price was reverified for this article. The domestic priority remains deliberate: overseas readers gain the most when they preserve the local-market context rather than treating the data as a global store.

zh-Hans.title: 海外买家如何使用中国自行车价格：人民币数字没有包含什么
zh-Hans.description: 区分国内观察价、汇率换算参考与出口报价，再核对具体配置、到货成本和售后。
zh-Hans.intro: China Bikes 主要记录中国大陆市场的购买信息。海外读者可以用它发现车型、核对规格，但人民币价格并不自动等于出口报价、到货总成本或全球保修。

sections.heading: 先辨认这是哪一种价格
paragraphs: 国内实际观察价、带优惠券的搜索卡片、官方标价和外币换算参考，属于不同证据。车型页保留观察日期与适用条件，帮助读者区分。某个换算数字也可能来自海外购买，而不是国内报价。
LCR018-D 就是例子：其车架参考价来自车主报告的外币购买金额，再按有日期的汇率换算。这不能变成独立观察到的国内结算价格。下表会保留价格依据，不把区别藏在人民币符号后面。

sections.heading: 确认出口报价对应同一辆车
paragraphs: 把比较中的车型代际、尺码、颜色和具体配件套餐发给卖家。问清报价针对裸车架、车架组、部分装配车辆，还是完整整车。地区版本与相似名称的配置，不能悄悄共用一个价格或重量。
使用车型页是为了明确问题，不是默认所有地区选项相同。图片里出现喜欢的轮组，不代表报价套餐一定包含它。

sections.heading: 建立到货成本清单，不要猜数
paragraphs: 分别列出商品报价、包装或处理费、运输、按需选择的保险、支付或换汇费用、目的地适用的进口费用，以及本地装配或检查费。向卖家、承运方和目的地相关机构取得当前金额及适用条件。本文不提供统一税率或关税估算。
未报价的项目保持空缺，不填零。每笔金额都标明币种与报价日期，再与本地可购买选项比较。国内起点价格很低，仍然不等于最终到货成本最低。

sections.heading: 把售后也纳入决定
paragraphs: 问清在目的地由谁受理保修、需要哪些凭证，以及运输和工时由谁承担。付款前确认退货流程，并询问尾钩、座管、把组等型号专用部件能否单独发货。
不要把国内保修声明理解成海外代理或车店必然提供支持。应取得适用于具体卖家、产品和目的地的政策。

sections.heading: 把目录当作研究起点最有用
paragraphs: 用它筛选明确车型、比较已记录接口并找到原始来源。[研究方法](/methodology/)解释记录事实、估算和待确认问题的区别。购买车架时，也可阅读[如何核算完整装车成本](/blog/frameset-vs-complete-bike-cost-in-china/)。
本文没有重新核实各目的地运输覆盖、库存或海外结算价。我们有意优先服务国内购买场景；海外读者保留这一市场背景，会比把数据当作全球商店更有收获。
